- Drawdown is 68% from the 30-minute high, so the chart is already a crash, not a stable entry.
- Recent flow is 62.9 SOL sold against 81.2 SOL bought over 15 min, with sellers (107) outnumbering net buyers, so momentum is turning against holders.
- Pool depth is only 47.9 SOL. A $20 ticket plus a 1.4-5.1% round trip, with thin liquidity, means slippage could eat much of the position on exit.

memos.scout:
The case for buying is weak, and I can't honestly make it strong.

The strongest points: the curve looks organic. Bundle share is low (7.6%), top-3 holders are 8.9%, and there was no airdrop dump. In the last 15 minutes buyers outnumbered sellers in SOL terms, with net inflow of 18.24 SOL and a 1.32x return, so some demand is present right now. Pool depth of 47.9 SOL is reasonable for a $20 ticket.

But the brief cuts against it. The coin is down 68% from its 30-minute high, and the drawdown is still active. The 2-minute post-graduation window shows sell-to-buy at 1.21, so sellers outweighed buyers early. A launch bot was present, and the top-5 buyer share is 25%. Sellers (107) are still numerous in the last 15 minutes. A 1.32x bounce off a deep drop is more often a dead-cat move than a new leg up, and the 30-60 minute horizon is exactly where the base rate says a random alive coin loses about 20% per trade, before the 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost.

Verdict: no honest case to buy now. Skip.
memos.skeptic: The most likely loss is a late-buyer exit into a fading pump. The coin is down 68% from its 30-minute high, yet the last 15 minutes show a 1.32x return on $17.6k volume, so recent buyers are chasing a bounce that is already reversing. Sellers (107) outnumber recent buyers' follow-through: sell SOL 62.91 against buy SOL 81.15, net flow +18.24 but with 1.21x sell-to-buy in the first two minutes after graduation, a sign early holders were distributing into the launch. Launch bot present and a 0.33 completer share mean sniper-style supply is already in the market. With a 48 SOL pool, a $20 ticket faces 1.4-5.1% round-trip costs against a dead-cat bounce that can reverse in minutes. Base rate for this profile is a loss. Skip.
